title: Inheritance Tax: claim for relief — loss on sale of land (IHT38)
text:
Use form IHT38 to claim Inheritance Tax relief when land or buildings that formed part of a deceased person’s estate are sold at a loss.

 The claim must be made by the person liable for the Inheritance Tax on the property.

 Relief is only available where qualifying sales are made within the permitted period following the date of death. In most cases, sales must be made within 3 years of the date of death, although some sales made within 4 years may also qualify.
changeNote: Details on when to use the form IHT38 have been updated.
